title: Impact on MediSave Withdrawal Limits When MediShield Life Premium Payments Rise
what_it_is: Impact on MediSave Withdrawal Limits When MediShield Life Premium Payments Rise

sections.label: MediSave payment of premiums
sections.summary: MediShield Life and Integrated Plan premiums are payable by MediSave, with Additional Withdrawal Limits of $300 to $900 yearly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MediShield Life premiums are fully payable by MediSave.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Family members can also utilise their MediSave also to help pay the premiums for their loved ones.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The additional private insurance component of the Integrated Plans (or IP) is also payable by MediSave, up to the Additional Withdrawal Limits (AWLs) which range from $300 to $900 per year, with higher limits for older policyholders as their premiums are higher.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The AWLs strike a balance between helping Singaporeans pay for their IP premiums using MediSave and ensuring that they have enough MediSave for basic healthcare needs, especially after their retirement.

sections.label: Basic MediShield Life coverage
sections.summary: Basic MediShield Life covers nine in 10 subsidised bills, and standardised B1 coverage gives an option beyond that.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, I will ask the Member to clarify again later.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But for the second question on the standard B1 coverage, we must understand that, at this moment, the Basic MediShield Life coverage already covers for nine out of 10 subsidised healthcare bills.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, the additional B1 coverage is really that little bit of icing on the cake and I think it would not be useful for CPF Board to take over all coverage, including up to B1, because there is still a role for the market to play.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But by standardising the level of coverage and ensuring that the premium is uniform, it gives Singaporeans the option to choose something beyond the coverage of nine in 10 that are already covered by the current Basic MediShield plans.

sections.label: Letting MediShield Life stabilise
sections.summary: MediShield Life should stabilise and its utilisation observed before deciding whether to include B1 coverage.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But at this moment, we will focus, because MediShield Life is still a very new plan that we had started in the last five years or so.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, we want to let it stabilise and see how the utilisation of the Basic plan, which covers nine in 10 subsidised bills, goes before deciding whether we should broaden the inclusion of B1 into our fold as well.
